Container.Name: risk-seven
Container.Overview: Risk Seven table. First to 200. Set WebUI Port — use the same free number for host and container. Add another container with a different port to run a second copy. Cloudflare: http://UNRAID_LAN_IP:that_port (HTTP).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port and container port. Required. Put the same free port in both boxes so you can run more than one copy.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Public https origin if you use a reverse proxy, e.g. https://riskseven.example.com
